text:
Elaine: Quick pre-launch check — we need final SEO + inbound routing for the webinar landing. Who has the canonical URL, keyword mapping, redirect list, and schema by EOD? @Taylor can you own redirects?

Taylor: On it. I have Sam's KW sheet from this morning. I'll draft 301s. Which canonical target do we lock to: /webinars/inference-costs-vs-performance or something shorter?

Sam: Shorter is better for CTR. My pick: /webinars/inference-economics. Primary kws: "LLM inference cost", "inference latency optimization", "inference best practices", "model serving cost". Secondary: "dedicated inference", "inference batching".

Rohit: Add enterprise queries too: "private LLM deployment", "VPC model hosting" — we see these in demo requests, want them in H1s and meta desc.

Jeff: For structured data, Event + FAQ + Organization. Include startDate, endDate, attendanceMode, and a short FAQ schema for the demo + pricing question. Example JSON-LD (very small):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Webinar: Inference Economics",
  "startDate": "2026-04-12T16:00:00Z",
  "location": {"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/inference-economics"}
}
```

Taylor: Redirect rules I'll apply (Netlify/_redirects style) — will PR: 
```
# keep one-to-one 301s, avoid chain
/old-webinar-inference    /webinars/inference-economics    301
/webinar-inference-2025   /webinars/inference-economics    301
/docs/old-inference-guide  /docs/inference/overview           301
```

Elaine: For inbound lead routing: add UTM campaign `webinar_inference_apr`. All form submissions should tag `source:webinar` and `campaign:webinar_inference_apr`. Route MQLs to AE queue with tag `webinar_inquiry`.

Sam: I'll add a HubSpot workflow: tag leads with `webinar_inference`, set lifecycle stage to MQL if attended OR watched recording, and assign to enterprise AE queue when company size >50.

SEO Bot: Crawl job scheduled at 2003457800 — will report 404s, redirect chains >2 hops, and schema validation errors.

Rohit: Internal linking: add 3 contextual CTAs from high-traffic docs (/docs/inference/overview, /blog/latency-patterns, /case-studies/dedicated) to the webinar page. Also add `rel=\"canonical\"` on any duplicate landing drafts.

Taylor: Will open redirect PR at 12:00 PST and include the redirect map + Netlify preview. Ping @Elaine for final approval. :thumbsup:

Elaine: Perfect — Sam/Taylor/Rohit own checklist items. I'll update the launch spreadsheet (Owner column) and confirm once PR is merged. Thanks everyone!
